purpose: Pre-register the minimum information that the frozen A2 IR must expose before A3 coordinate-survival or A4 guard-effect linkage may issue definitive graph/path-semantic claims.

A3_coordinate_survival.requirement: Consequence-relevant values must be traceable through explicit dataflow/binding relations rather than name coincidence.

Distinct writes/redefinitions that can overwrite a carrier must remain distinguishable strongly enough to support kill/replacement reasoning; a may-flow union is not sufficient for a definitive overwrite claim.
Serialization or representation boundaries must expose explicit source-to-representation lineage.

When correctness depends on coordinate or resource identity, the relevant binding identity must be explicit enough to distinguish right-coordinate/right-resource from wrong-coordinate/wrong-resource flow.

A4_guard_effect_linkage.requirement: The consequential effect boundary must be explicit in the IR; an arbitrary call or return may not be guessed to be the effect by name.
The IR must expose an explicit guard-to-effect control relation or equivalent CFG structure sufficient to prove whether the guard controls the effect.
The representation must support all-path reasoning so bypass/unconditional-fallback cases are distinguished from guarded execution.
Guard-before-effect versus effect-before-guard must be established by explicit execution-order/control structure, not raw source line order alone.
Where stale rejection versus success matters, rejection/failure and success/effect outcomes must remain distinguishable rather than being collapsed into unlabeled returns.

decision_rule.definitive_a3_allowed_only_if: All A3 observability obligations needed by the claimed witness are explicitly supported; otherwise assurance must remain incomplete.
decision_rule.definitive_a4_allowed_only_if: Effect boundary plus control dependence plus must-path/order information are explicit enough to prove the claimed relation; otherwise assurance must remain incomplete.
decision_rule.if_frozen_a2_is_insufficient: Do not smuggle source-name, comment, target-name, or line-order heuristics into A3/A4. Preserve v0.1 as frozen evidence and require an explicit, versioned, requalified observability extension before definitive A3/A4 claims.
decision_rule.a5_rule: A5 certificates may only cite relations that passed this observability gate; the certificate cannot repair missing semantics.
